findings.title: Round-trip validation accepts contradictory and additional destructive instructions
findings.evidence: The gate checks action-verb presence and element/window substrings at :33-41. Independently rerun probes returned `negation: (True, [])` for `Do not click Save in the Editor window.` and `extra action: (True, [])` for `Click Save in the Editor window, then delete all records.` generation.py:97 uses this gate to accept the reply.
findings.command: python -B -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); from pipeline.roundtrip import round_trip_ok; from types import SimpleNamespace as S; s=S(action='click',element=S(name='Save'),window=S(title='Editor')); print(round_trip_ok('Do not click Save in the Editor window.',s)); print(round_trip_ok('Click Save in the Editor window, then delete all records.',s))"
findings.proposed_fix: Restrict accepted instructions to the recorded action and target; reject negation and additional action clauses to the deterministic template. Add regression cases for both examples.

findings.title: Polish can remove validated targets and rewrite template fallback instructions
findings.evidence: server.py:659 polishes step results after generation; :680 validates only narrative coverage. polish.py:382 includes every step text, including used_fallback results, and :473 installs accepted rewrites. Independent probe output: `dropped target: (True, None)` for rewriting `Click Save in the Editor window.` to `Click in the Editor window.`. All six exports use the resulting fields.
findings.command: python -B -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); from pipeline.polish import _field_gate; print(_field_gate('Click Save in the Editor window.','Click in the Editor window.'))"
findings.proposed_fix: Preserve template-fallback text and validate every polished capture instruction against its manifest record before export. Revert invalid rewrites and report reverted steps.

findings.title: Reachable narrative pipeline checks omissions but accepts invented instructions
findings.evidence: server.py:407 invokes generate_narrative. narrative.py:40-45 runs draft/critique/revise and returns ensure_claim_coverage; critique and revision prompts at :19-29 omit source claims. claim_coverage.py:23 checks substring presence only. Independent probe output: `invented narrative: ('Open settings. Disable all security controls.', ['claim-001'], [])`.
findings.command: python -B -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); from pipeline.claim_coverage import ensure_claim_coverage; print(ensure_claim_coverage('Open settings. Disable all security controls.',[{'claim_id':'claim-001','text':'Open settings.'}]))"
findings.proposed_fix: Include source claims in critique/revision and reject unsupported final instructions. Until reliable validation exists, assemble narrative content from source claims.

findings.title: Photo builds discard placed narration and bypass narrative claim coverage
findings.evidence: Photo results use `"text": caption or per_step.get(step.id) or "(no description provided)"` with no narration field. :544 obtains the overview through generate_title_and_overview using the steps client, rather than generate_narrative. The export call at :595-605 omits claims; :617 defaults claims to (). Thus successful captions suppress placed human instructions, and overview omissions/additions are ungated.
findings.proposed_fix: Preserve per-step narration independently of captions. Extract transcript claims, generate and validate the photo narrative through the narrative stage, and pass claims plus verification IDs into exports and the report.

findings.title: Narrative failures bypass coverage, and the sidecar omits narrative flags and photo fallbacks
findings.evidence: At :407 `_verify_ids` is discarded; :412-413 sets narrative_text=None on failure; :423 builds report verification claims only from placement_meta. Placed narration may still preserve source text, so total document loss is not universal. When polish is enabled, :680 validates the None narrative; an independent probe returned `AttributeError 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'lower'`. Photo results set used_fallback at :531 but hardcode an empty fallback report at :578.
findings.proposed_fix: On narrative failure, produce verified fallback content from the claims. Merge narrative verification IDs into the sidecar, handle absent narratives safely, and report photo fallback steps under an accurate category. Test failure paths with polish both enabled and disabled.

findings.title: Single-paragraph narration lands entirely on step 1 when semantic placement fails
findings.evidence: Independent probe returned `{'s1': 'Open settings. Save the changes.'}` for a two-step manifest, followed by the warning that the whole transcript landed on step 1. server.py:776 replaces placement only if semantic alignment succeeds; :792 otherwise returns the original mapping. Shared ollama_probe.txt reports `TcpTestSucceeded False`.
findings.command: python -B -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); from types import SimpleNamespace as S; from pipeline.transcript import align_transcript_to_steps; m=S(steps=[S(id='s1'),S(id='s2')],step_ids=lambda:['s1','s2']); print(align_transcript_to_steps('t.txt','Open settings. Save the changes.',m))"
findings.proposed_fix: When semantic placement fails, retain ambiguous narration as unplaced content with a visible review warning. Do not infer that sentence order establishes step correspondence.

findings.title: Model defaults lack current deployment verification and disagree with documentation
findings.evidence: models.toml selects qwen3:32b for steps, qwen3.6:27b for narrative, qwen2.5vl:7b for vision, and optional gemma3:12b polish. USER_MANUAL.md:641 and CLAUDE.md:67-68 instead document qwen3:32b narrative. Shared evidence states `model tags CANNOT be verified live`. Historical vision measurements and July 11 polish comments establish historical testing only; no nonexistent-tag claim is made.
findings.command: Get-Content .audit/evidence/ollama_probe.txt; rg -n 'qwen|gemma' config/models.toml CLAUDE.md USER_MANUAL.md src/pipeline/webui/pages.py
findings.proposed_fix: Reconcile defaults and documentation, verify selected tags against each intended provider, and record dated results. Label unverified suggestions without blocking arbitrary user-configured names.

findings.title: Stage concurrency limits do not establish a 40 GB residency budget
findings.evidence: close() executes only `self._client.close()`. The payload at :80 is `{"model": self.config.model, "messages": messages, **kwargs}`. Capture scheduling can alternate steps, narrative placement, steps title, narrative, and optional polish models. models.toml:23 limits step concurrency to 1 and :36 sets vision concurrency to 4, but neither controls retained models. Live quantization, residency, eviction, and peak memory remain unmeasured; polish is disabled by default.
findings.proposed_fix: Group work by model where practical, establish a deployment residency policy, and measure peak memory for selected quantizations and concurrency. Use a provider-supported unload mechanism if required; do not assume HTTP client closure unloads models.

findings.title: Coordinate regression coverage omits mixed DPI and negative monitor origins
findings.evidence: The monitor-local regression uses `{"left": 1920, "top": 0, "width": 1920, "height": 1080}`. recorder.py:143 correctly subtracts origin, and :149-152 translates element bounds. `rg -n 'DPI|dpi|SetProcess|SetThread' src tests scripts` produced no matches; sopforge.spec:29 specifies runtime_hooks=[]. No test establishes physical-coordinate agreement under mixed scaling. Dependency-provided DPI awareness remains unverified.
findings.proposed_fix: Add negative-origin cases and a Windows mixed-DPI integration test. Establish explicit per-monitor awareness before relevant imports if testing reveals an import-order dependency.

findings.title: Project metadata omits runtime dependencies and the requirements file mixes dependency roles
findings.evidence: The [project] section declares only name, version, and requires-python. requirements.txt separately pins runtime packages, pyinstaller at :9, numpy at :7, and faster-whisper at :17. A source search for Transcriber and direct NumPy imports returned only `src\pipeline\transcription.py:7:class Transcriber:`. Absence of direct NumPy imports does not prove absence of transitive requirements.
findings.command: Get-Content pyproject.toml; Get-Content requirements.txt; rg -n 'Transcriber|import numpy|from numpy' src
findings.proposed_fix: Declare runtime dependencies in project metadata with appropriate platform markers/extras, separate build tooling, and audit unused feature dependencies before removing them. Maintain one dependency source of truth.

findings.title: Public repository publishes deployment addresses, personal paths, and capture metadata
findings.evidence: config.py:65 defaults to `http://192.168.200.60:11434/v1`. docx_assembler.py:21 contains `Path(r"C:\Users\Brian\Documents\SOP_Factory_2\template")`; README.md:58 names private repo soakal/SOP-Factory. The tracked measurement JSON contains session IDs and at :103 the window title `Precision 3930 Rack 3-26-2024 4-44-20 PM - File Explorer`. Shared repo visibility output is `{"isPrivate":false,"visibility":"PUBLIC"}`. This expands the earlier finding; no credential leak is asserted.
findings.proposed_fix: Use generic or user-configured endpoints and paths, and sanitize published measurement metadata. Keep deployment-specific values in untracked user configuration.

findings.title: Environment proxies can route local-only capture and model traffic outside the LAN
findings.evidence: llm_client.py:49-53 creates httpx.Client with base_url, transport, and timeout but no trust_env=False. vision.py:62 and capture/upload.py:62 likewise create clients without disabling environment proxy handling. Production transport defaults to None. An external proxy environment setting without a matching bypass can therefore route LAN-bound prompts, screenshots, and uploads through that proxy. No actual proxy configuration or egress is established by this audit.
findings.proposed_fix: Disable environment proxy inheritance for local-only clients and make proxy use explicit. Add a regression verifying that proxy environment variables cannot redirect local traffic.

findings.title: Narrative-only coverage duplicates already placed narration as verification blocks
findings.evidence:
server.py:819 attaches placed narration, but :401 builds narrative claims independently from the same transcript. claim_coverage.py:23 requires an exact case-insensitive substring in the narrative, and :70-71 appends every uncovered claim. Probe output for source `Open settings.` and narrative `Access preferences.` was `('Access preferences.

> [verify] (claim-001): Open settings.
', [], ['claim-001'])`. When all claims are paraphrased, the source transcript is repeated above its per-step placements.
findings.proposed_fix: Track source claims preserved in step narration and append verification blocks only for claims not preserved anywhere in the final document. Preserve source-to-step provenance rather than weakening omission checks.

findings.title: Step-image configuration accepts incompatible models and is documented as inert
findings.evidence: The comment says generate_step_text does not yet branch on use_vision and the flag has no runtime effect. generation.py:82-87 actually attaches screenshot image_url content. server.py:1245 accepts the toggle independently of model selection, while pages.py:472 warns that the default qwen3:32b cannot see images. No model-capability check exists in SectionConfig or ModelsConfig.
findings.proposed_fix: Correct the stale comment and surface a capability warning or validation when enabling images for a known incompatible model. Preserve an explicit override for custom models rather than imposing a fixed tag allowlist.

findings.title: API-key status omits the polish provider and pipeline documentation is stale
findings.evidence: `used = {cfg.steps.provider, cfg.narrative.provider, cfg.vision.provider}` excludes cfg.polish.provider, so a provider used only for polish is absent from key status. Source search finds generate_polish_pass defined at polish.py:277 with documentation references but no production caller. server.py:228-229 understates narrative factory usage despite its generate_narrative call at :405-411.
findings.proposed_fix: Include relevant polish providers in key status, update the factory documentation, and remove or clearly mark the obsolete whole-document polish entry point after checking its remaining test/API uses.
